subject: The Sea of Fire
text: Falling into the lava in the Sea of Fire requires collecting all five Silver Rupees over again.

evidence.quote: If you fall in this room at any time, you will have to get all of the Silver Rupees over again.

subject: Silver Rupee
text: The first Silver Rupee in the Sea of Fire is reached by pulling Link to the Longshot target above the entrance doorway.

evidence.quote: Pull yourself up to the Longshot target here with the Hookshot/Longshot to get the first Silver Rupee.

subject: Silver Rupee
text: A second Silver Rupee is located on a platform to the left of the cliff edge in the Sea of Fire.

evidence.quote: Walk to the edge of the cliff, and on the left you will see a platform with another Silver Rupee on it.  Jump down to it.

subject: Blocks of Time
text: Playing the Song of Time where Navi flutters in the Sea of Fire causes two Blocks of Time to appear.

evidence.quote: Navi will flutter out into an empty space in the middle of the room; play the Song of Time here to make two Blocks of Time appear (if only one appears, you didn't get close enough - but one is enough).

subject: Small Key
text: A Small Key lies on the high ledge against the right wall, reached by jumping from the Blocks of Time.

evidence.quote: Climb up onto the Blocks of Time, and from there jump to the high ledge against the right wall.  Take the Small Key that lies up here.

subject: Silver Rupee
text: Jumping left from the lower Block of Time leads to a third Silver Rupee, and jumping from the block to another platform leads to a fourth.

evidence.quote: Jump back out to the lower Block of Time, and from there jump to the left to get another Silver Rupee.  Jump back to the Block of Time, and then jump out to the next platform with a Silver Rupee on it.

subject: switch
text: Hitting the switch on the platform to the right temporarily shuts off the pillar of flames on the other side of the room to allow access to the last Silver Rupee.

evidence.quote: Look to the right here to see another platform, which has a switch on it.  This switch deactivates the pillar of flames on the other side of the room, letting you get the last Silver Rupee.

subject: door
text: Gathering all five Silver Rupees in the Sea of Fire unseals the exit door on the left side of the room.

evidence.quote: Once you have all five Silver Rupees, the door on the left side of the room will unseal.

subject: Blocks of Time
text: Playing the Song of Time in the center of the Underwater Rupee Room makes the floor Blocks of Time vanish, revealing a pool of water.

evidence.quote: Run into the middle of the room, and play the Song of Time to make the Blocks of Time in the floor vanish.  Equip the Iron Boots and the Zora Tunic, and then sink into the pool of water beneath the Blocks of Time.

subject: Shell Blade
text: Shell Blades at the bottom of the pool in the Underwater Rupee Room can be defeated with the Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Defeat all of the Shell Blades at the bottom of the pool with the Hookshot, and watch out for the Blade Trap.

subject: Small Key
text: Collecting all five Silver Rupees in the Underwater Rupee Room spawns a chest above the pool containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Once you have all five Silver Rupees, a chest will appear back above the pool of water.  Climb out of the pool and open the chest to get a Small Key.

subject: The Sea of Fire
text: The door on the left side of the Sea of Fire leads into the Dinolfos Room.

evidence.quote: From the door to the Underwater Rupee Room, head to the left side of the Sea of Fire and go through the door there.

subject: Dinolfos Room
text: The Dinolfos Room requires defeating all enemies within a 1:30 time limit.

evidence.quote:
Hint: Defeat all the enemies in a LIMITED TIME!
Time Limit: 1:30

subject: Beamos
text: The Beamos in the Dinolfos Room can be blown up using a Bomb or Bombchus.

evidence.quote: Blow up the Beamos statue with a Bomb or Bombchus, and then kill the Dinofols in the room.

subject: Small Key
text: Defeating both Dinolfos and the Beamos in the Dinolfos Room spawns a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Once both of the Dinolfos and the Beamos are dead, then a chest containing a Small Key will appear.  Take the Small Key, and then go through the door to the left of the Dinolfos Room to return to the entrance.

subject: Treasure Room
text: The Treasure Room is entered through the door across from the dungeon entrance.

evidence.quote: Go through the door across from the entrance and into the Treasure Room.

subject: Treasure Room
text: The Treasure Room has nine locked doors, with the final key hidden inside the room itself.

evidence.quote: This room contains nine locked doors - which might seem problematic, since you only have eight keys (seven if you tried this dungeon before you got the Silver Gauntlets).  Luckily, the ninth key is hidden in the room itself.

subject: Small Key
text: Climbing the wire wall through the ceiling passage revealed by the Lens of Truth in the first room on the left leads to a chest with a Small Key.

evidence.quote: In the first room on the left, use the Lens of Truth and look on the ceiling above to find a hidden passage.  Use the wire wall to the left of the door to climb up into it...At the top, you'll find a chest which contains Key #8/#9.

subject: Treasure Room
text: Chests on the right side of the Treasure Room contain Bombchus and a Bundle of Arrows.

evidence.quote:
Right from the entrance -
Bombchus, Bundle of Arrows

subject: Treasure Room
text: Chests on the left side of the Treasure Room contain a Purple Rupee, a Red Rupee, a Bundle of Arrows, and the Ice Arrows.

evidence.quote:
Left from the entrance -
Purple Rupee, Red Rupee, Bundle of Arrows, Ice Arrows

subject: Treasure Room
text: Warp songs cannot be played inside the Gerudo Training Ground, requiring Link to walk out.

evidence.quote: Once you have the Ice Arrows, then you can just leave (you'll have to walk out - warp songs don't work in here).

subject: Big Poe Hunting Sidequest
text: Big Poes can only be captured as Adult Link while riding Epona and using the Fairy Bow.

evidence.quote: Big Poes can only be obtained with Epona and the Bow and Arrows, as Adult Link.  If you don't have either Epona or the Bow and Arrows, then you can't capture them.

subject: Big Poe
text: Shooting a Big Poe with two arrows turns it into a Wisp that can be captured in an Empty Bottle.

evidence.quote: After killing a Big Poe with two arrows, then it will become a Wisp which can be captured like a normal Poe in an Empty Bottle.

subject: Bottle
text: Delivering all ten captured Big Poes to the Poe Shop in Hyrule Castle rewards the final Bottle.

evidence.quote: Deliver captured Big Poes to the Poe Shop in Hyrule Castle (the building on the left as you first enter Hyrule Castle).  Once you capture all ten and take them to the Poe Man, he'll give you the game's final bottle.

subject: Big Poe
text: Regular Poes appear while on foot, whereas Big Poes only appear while riding horseback on Epona.

evidence.quote: Regular Poes appear in the same places that Big Poes do while on foot.  These can be killed while on foot, but don't be fooled; they don't count as Big Poes.  Big Poes only appear while on horseback

subject: Big Poe #01
text: Big Poe #01 appears by the signpost immediately south of Hyrule Castle when riding west from the stone bridge near Kakariko Village.

evidence.quote:
Big Poe #01
Location: The signpost immediately south of Hyrule Castle.

The best way to get this Poe is to ride west from the stone bridge near Kakariko Village straight at the signpost south of Hyrule Castle.

subject: Big Poe #02
text: Big Poe #02 appears on the cliff overlooking the entrance to Kakariko Village when Link rides right up to the cliff's edge.

evidence.quote:
Big Poe #02
Location:  The cliff overlooking the entrance to Kakariko Village.

This is hands-down the hardest Big Poe in the game to kill.  Pretty much the only way to make it appear is to ride right up to the edge of the cliff, at which point the Poe will appear and begin to fly away.

subject: Big Poe #03
text: Big Poe #03 appears at the point where the stone wall east of Lon Lon Ranch breaks to the left when riding south along its eastern edge.

evidence.quote:
Big Poe #03
Location:  The stone wall east of Lon Lon Ranch.

This one is much easier then Big Poe #02.  Simply ride south along the wall's eastern edge, and the Big Poe will appear at the point where the wall breaks to the left.

subject: Big Poe #04
text: Big Poe #04 appears at the intersection of the Y-Shaped Road southeast of Lon Lon Ranch when riding west past the gray stone toward the fence gap.

evidence.quote:
Big Poe #04
Location:  The intersection of the Y-Shaped Road southeast of Lon Lon Ranch.

This Big Poe is quite easy.  The best way to get it is to ride west from the entrance to Kokiri Forest, straight for the gray stone near the crossroads of the Y-Shaped road...Keep heading west past the stone, and the Big Poe will appear.

subject: Big Poe #06
text: Big Poe #06 appears south of the tall tree at the bottom tip of the Y-Shaped Road when riding from east to west.

evidence.quote:
Big Poe #06
Location:  South of the tree at the bottom tip of the Y-Shaped Road.

Head for the bottom tip of the Y-Shaped Road, and you will find a tall tree standing by itself.  Riding from the east to the west, pass by the south side of this tree to make the Big Poe appear.

subject: Big Poe #05
text: Big Poe #05 appears in the center of the grove of golden-leafed trees in southeast Hyrule Field when riding at the gap to the right of the tan stone.

evidence.quote:
Big Poe #05
Location:  The center of the grove of golden-leafed trees in Southeast Hyrule
Field....Look for the tan-
colored stone in the middle of the grove of trees, and start riding at the gap
to the right of the stone.  The Poe will appear in this gap
